title: HtmlStrong
responsibility: Renders the native strong element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlStrong.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native strong element; native HTML content rules still apply. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (no child snippet).

outputs.name: HtmlStrong
outputs.description: The actual native strong element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper. All remaining caller props are optional forwarded native attributes, DOM properties, data/aria values and event handlers. Omitted keys are not set by the atom, leaving browser defaults; supply them directly rather than through a nested attributes prop.

errors.name: Caller content or event error
errors.description: Supplied event handlers and rendered child snippets may throw; the atom does not catch their errors. Void elements ignore the child snippet.

errors.name: Native attribute or property error
errors.description: Errors raised while evaluating supplied props or setting native attributes/properties propagate. Invalid property values may produce a browser TypeError or DOMException.
